title: A Dinner for a Lost Friend and a Falling Market
titleZh: 怀念老友的晚餐与股市下跌
description: Steven describes a dinner with former colleagues held in memory of a friend who died recently, and the conversation about Beijing housing prices, the cost of raising foreign kids in China and how foreigners talk about the country. He also updates the SSAB stock spreadsheet as the market slides, covering Nvidia, Google, gold and Anthropic's new Nasdaq listing.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Episode overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目里，史蒂文聊了一场特别的晚餐：他和以前的同事、朋友聚在一起，纪念一个大约一个月前去世的朋友。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about a special dinner: he got together with former colleagues and friends to remember a friend who passed away about a month ago.

sentences.zh: 这顿饭也让他想起了自己为什么坚持录这些“看似无聊”的播客。
sentences.en: The dinner also reminded him why he keeps recording these "seemingly boring" podcasts.

sentences.zh: 接着他们谈到北京的房价、外国人养孩子的花销，以及外国人怎么谈论中国。
sentences.en: Then they talked about Beijing housing prices, the cost of raising children as a foreigner, and how foreigners talk about China.

sentences.zh: 最后，股市一路下跌，他更新了 SSAB 的谷歌股票表格。
sentences.en: Finally, with the stock market falling steadily, he updated the SSAB Google stock spreadsheet.

sentences.zh: 节目录于晚上 11 点 48 分，他嗓子有点哑，请大家多包涵。
sentences.en: The episode was recorded at 11:48 p.m., and his voice is a bit hoarse, so please bear with him.

sentences.zh: 为朋友而聚的晚餐
sentences.en: A dinner gathering for a friend

sentences.zh: 几周前，史蒂文提到，一位在北京认识的前同事兼好友去世了。
sentences.en: A few weeks ago, Steven mentioned that a former colleague and good friend he had met in Beijing had passed away.

sentences.zh: 今晚，十来个认识他的人聚在亮马桥的一家墨西哥餐厅，就在美国大使馆对面。
sentences.en: Tonight, about ten people who knew him gathered at a Mexican restaurant in Liangmaqiao, right across from the US Embassy.

sentences.zh: 这不是一个伤感的夜晚，反而挺开心。
sentences.en: It wasn't a sad evening; on the contrary, it was quite cheerful.

sentences.zh: 大多数人是他的前同事，史蒂文是其中唯一离开北京的人。
sentences.en: Most of them were his former colleagues, and Steven was the only one among them who had left Beijing.

sentences.zh: 第 34 期节目，与旧播客的“暂停”
sentences.en: Episode 34, and the "pause" of the old podcast

sentences.zh: 这位朋友曾做客史蒂文旧播客的第 34 期。
sentences.en: This friend was once a guest on episode 34 of Steven's old podcast.

sentences.zh: 那一期他们聊了大约四个小时，喝了五六瓶酒。
sentences.en: In that episode they talked for about four hours and drank five or six bottles of wine.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文在饭桌上说：“我唯一的遗憾，就是我们一直没能再录一期不喝酒的。”
sentences.en: At the dinner table Steven said, "My only regret is that we never managed to record another episode without drinking."

sentences.zh: 2024 年以后，两人总是错开：史蒂文在加拿大时，朋友在北京；史蒂文回北京了，朋友又去了美国和欧洲。
sentences.en: After 2024, the two kept missing each other: when Steven was in Canada, his friend was in Beijing; when Steven returned to Beijing, his friend had gone to the US and Europe.

sentences.zh: 为什么不用 Zoom？
sentences.en: Why not use Zoom?

sentences.zh: 因为很多嘉宾想面对面录，史蒂文就得打扫房间、布置镜头，全程一个人包办，付出和收获不成正比。
sentences.en: Because many guests want to record face to face, Steven has to clean the room and set up the cameras, doing everything himself, and the effort isn't worth the return.

sentences.zh: 所以这个播客是暂停，而不是结束，将来也许会改成视频播客。
sentences.en: So this podcast is on pause, not over, and in the future it may become a video podcast.

sentences.zh: 今晚的聚会让他想起：去过的地方、一起相处的人，一定要留下照片、录音和视频。
sentences.en: Tonight's gathering reminded him: for the places you've been and the people you've spent time with, you must keep photos, recordings, and videos.

sentences.zh: 饭桌上的人，和“常联系”的理由
sentences.en: The people at the dinner table, and a reason to "keep in touch"

sentences.zh: 除了同事，其他人都是通过这位朋友认识的。
sentences.en: Apart from a coworker, everyone else knew each other through this friend.

sentences.zh: 国际学校的那位老师说，2018 年他在曼谷与这位朋友不期而遇。
sentences.en: The teacher from the international school said that in 2018 he ran into this friend by chance in Bangkok.

sentences.zh: 他感叹：“像这样坐在一起的机会，以后还能有几次？”
sentences.en: He sighed: "How many more chances will we get to sit together like this?"

sentences.zh: 他还提到教会圈子里的老说法：坏事总是接二连三，人走也是三个一组。
sentences.en: He also brought up an old saying from church circles: bad things always come one after another, and people pass away in threes.

sentences.zh: 他讲这话是想让大家放松，不是吓人。
sentences.en: He said this to put everyone at ease, not to scare anyone.

sentences.zh: 不过，这倒是个好理由：多给在乎的人发条消息，问一句“嘿，最近怎么样？”
sentences.en: Still, it's actually a good reason to message the people you care about more often and ask, "Hey, how have you been lately?"

sentences.zh: 北京的房价
sentences.en: Housing prices in Beijing

sentences.zh: 晚餐的一大话题是生活成本。
sentences.en: One big topic at dinner was the cost of living.

sentences.zh: 在北京待了十五到二十年的人，大多买了房。
sentences.en: Most people who have been in Beijing for fifteen to twenty years have bought property.

sentences.zh: 他们来的时候房子便宜，英语教学的工作又多，“能赚的时候就赚了一大笔”。
sentences.en: When they came, housing was cheap and there were plenty of English-teaching jobs, so "they made a fortune while they could."

sentences.zh: 这样的机会如今已经不多了。
sentences.en: Opportunities like that are rare these days.

sentences.zh: 一位年轻的美国爸爸说，他们在望京看房，一套要价约 150 万美元，还在贬值。
sentences.en: A young American dad said they had been looking at apartments in Wangjing, with one asking about 1.5 million US dollars, and still losing value.

sentences.zh: 政府为了托市降低了首付，可对一套还在跌的房子，谁愿意付三成首付？
sentences.en: The government lowered down payments to prop up the market, but who wants to put 30% down on an apartment that's still falling in value?

sentences.zh: 如果只要一成，约十万美元，史蒂文和女朋友倒可以考虑。
sentences.en: If it were only 10%, about 100,000 US dollars, Steven and his girlfriend might actually consider it.

sentences.zh: 房市触底了吗？
sentences.en: Has the housing market hit bottom?

sentences.zh: 没人知道。
sentences.en: Nobody knows.

sentences.zh: 外国孩子与学费
sentences.en: Foreign children and school fees

sentences.zh: 饭桌上有三位外国爸爸，都有孩子。
sentences.en: There were three foreign dads at the dinner table, and all of them had children.

sentences.zh: 两位孩子较大的，听起来打算留下来。
sentences.en: The two with older children sounded like they planned to stay.

sentences.zh: 年轻的那位能想象回美国，但不确定妻子是否愿意。
sentences.en: The younger one could imagine moving back to the US, but wasn't sure whether his wife would want to.

sentences.zh: 常见的做法是：外籍家庭待到孩子上初中，就搬回老家，既躲过高考的压力，也省下昂贵的国际学校学费。
sentences.en: A common approach is for foreign families to stay until their kids start middle school, then move back home, avoiding the pressure of the gaokao and saving on expensive international school fees.

sentences.zh: 回国后收入也许少些，但教育便宜得多。
sentences.en: After returning home, their income might be a bit lower, but education is much cheaper.

sentences.zh: 外国人怎么谈中国？
sentences.en: How do foreigners talk about China?

sentences.zh: 这个话题值得单独做一期。
sentences.en: This topic deserves its own episode.

sentences.zh: 当时在座的有三位中国女士和一位北京出生的男士，史蒂文很清楚外国人是怎么谈论这个国家的。
sentences.en: Present at the time were three Chinese women and a man born in Beijing, and Steven knew very well how foreigners talk about this country.

sentences.zh: 他直言：“我不信任这个国家，抱歉，我就是不信任。”
sentences.en: He said bluntly: "I don't trust this country. Sorry, I just don't trust it."

sentences.zh: 那位年轻爸爸则说，他对自己的祖国也不信任。
sentences.en: The young father, for his part, said he didn't trust his own home country either.

sentences.zh: 问题到底出在中国，还是出在他自己和他的选择？
sentences.en: Is the problem really China, or is it him and his choices?

sentences.zh: 这里成功的外国人创业公司在哪儿？
sentences.en: Where are the successful foreign-run startups here?

sentences.zh: 懂中文又有多大帮助？
sentences.en: And how much does knowing Chinese actually help?

sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，一位翻译向他解释了将要发生的事，然后就跟着警卫走了，他在拘留室里待了一整天，“还是不知道到底发生了什么”。
sentences.en: Earlier this year, an interpreter explained to him what was about to happen, and then he went off with the guards. He spent an entire day in a detention room, "still not knowing what was actually going on."

sentences.zh: 继续做播客，更新股票表
sentences.en: Still podcasting, and updating the stock list

sentences.zh: 没错，他还在做播客。
sentences.en: That's right, he's still doing the podcast.

sentences.zh: 不过今晚没有直播，以后也未必天天直播。
sentences.en: But there's no livestream tonight, and in the future there won't necessarily be one every day.

sentences.zh: 这个周末，他要剪完视频博客，还要批改大约 50 篇学生作文。
sentences.en: This weekend he has to finish editing a vlog and also grade about 50 student essays.

sentences.zh: 那么，是该抄底，还是该哭？
sentences.en: So, is it time to buy the dip, or time to cry?

sentences.zh: 从 11 月 12 日他选的那批股票算起，英伟达跌了 12%，苹果跌 1.6%，美光跌 13.5%，CoreWeave 跌 20.65%。
sentences.en: Counting from the batch of stocks he picked on November 12, Nvidia is down 12%, Apple down 1.6%, Micron down 13.5%, and CoreWeave down 20.65%.

sentences.zh: 十月底加进来的劳斯莱斯则涨了 13% 到 14%。
sentences.en: Rolls-Royce, added at the end of October, is up 13% to 14%, on the other hand.

sentences.zh: 今天新增的有：
sentences.en: New additions today:

sentences.zh: Anthropic（刚在纳斯达克上市，欢迎入局）
sentences.en: Anthropic (just listed on Nasdaq, welcome to the game)

sentences.zh: Alphabet/谷歌和 CoreWeave
sentences.en: Alphabet/Google and CoreWeave

sentences.zh: 标普指数、罗素 2000 指数和黄金
sentences.en: The S&P index, the Russell 2000 index, and gold

sentences.zh: RSI、英伟达与“恐惧时买入”
sentences.en: RSI, Nvidia, and "Buy When Others Are Fearful"

sentences.zh: 这些股票很多在 RSI（相对强弱指数）上已经超卖，之后通常会反弹，至少短期如此。
sentences.en: Many of these stocks are already oversold on the RSI (Relative Strength Index), and they usually bounce back afterward, at least in the short term.

sentences.zh: 谷歌两周前就是这样，劳斯莱斯十月也是。
sentences.en: That's what happened with Google two weeks ago, and with Rolls-Royce in October too.

sentences.zh: 现在轮到英伟达了，价格是 136.88 美元。
sentences.en: Now it's Nvidia's turn, at a price of 136.88 dollars.

sentences.zh: 黄金每克跌了 300 元人民币，也许是恐慌性抛售。
sentences.en: Gold fell 300 yuan per gram; maybe it's panic selling.

sentences.zh: 别人恐惧时贪婪，别人贪婪时恐惧。
sentences.en: Be greedy when others are fearful, and fearful when others are greedy.

sentences.zh: 如果你害怕，就写下原因，周一再看一遍。
sentences.en: If you're scared, write down why, and look at it again on Monday.

sentences.zh: 这不是投资建议。
sentences.en: This is not investment advice.

sentences.zh: “你的钱，你自己负责。”
sentences.en: "Your money, your responsibility."

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 不管是朋友还是股票，你都不知道它能陪你多久。
sentences.en: Whether it's friends or stocks, you never know how long they'll stay with you.

sentences.zh: 多拍照，多录音，常问候身边的人，投资前做好自己的功课。
sentences.en: Take more photos, make more recordings, check in often with the people around you, and do your own homework before investing.
